lines: Faculty of Social Science - Transitional Justice and Post-Conflict Reconstruction Centre - Department of Political Science
Completion of first-year requirements including 1.0 essay course in Social Science or Arts and Humanities with a mark of at least 60%.
1.0 course: Transitional Justice 2001F/G and Transitional Justice 3001F/G.

1.0 course from: History 2423F/G or Political Science 2423F/G, Philosophy 2065F/G, Political Science 3340F/G, Political Science 3366E, Political Science 4411F/G, the former History 3419F/G, the former History 3427E, the former Political Science 3325E, (theme 'Conflict').

1.0 course from: French 3140B, Philosophy 2080, Philosophy 2821F/G, Philosophy 3810F/G, Philosophy 3820F/G, Political Science 3201F/G, Political Science 3398F/G, Political Science 4426F/G, Political Science 4427F/G, the former Political Science 3346E, the former Social Justice and Peace Studies 2200E (theme 'Transitional Justice and Post-Conflict Reconstruction').

1.0 course from: English 3670F/G, English 3680F/G (formerly English 3880F/G), GSWS 2260, GSWS 2270A/B, History 2110A/B, History 2147A/B, Indigenous Studies 2218F/G, Indigenous Studies 3880F/G, Philosophy 2750F/G, Philosophy 2810F/G, Political Science 3388E, Sociology 2212A/B, Sociology 2260A/B, Sociology 3260A/B, the former Anthropology 2218F/G (theme 'Elective Courses that inform Transitional Justice').
No course may be credited toward another module. Please note the prerequisites for senior courses.
